exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Vascular wall restoration, anti-thrombotic activity, and systemic blood pressure stabilization
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Aqueous extraction in boiling water or hot dashi broth

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Upregulation of mitochondrial uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) in adipose tissue
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Stimulates non-shivering thermogenesis and enhances metabolic lipid clearance
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Direct dietary consumption of whole green laver

penalties_and_risks: High salinity (25-35 PSU) causes aggressive galvanic corrosion on standard steel gantry hardware.
Erratic fluidic tumbling makes real-time optical segmentation and biomass volume calculation unreliable.
human_culinary_use: Deep umami, aromatic oceanic profile. Crumbled over noodle bowls, steeped into dashi broths, or flash-toasted into savory seasoning flakes.
